scripts.build: pnpm generate:icons && vp build && node scripts/check-server-bundle.mjs && pnpm build:checkin-runtime
scripts.test:checkin-host: pnpm build:checkin-runtime && node --test tests/checkin-serial-devices.test.mjs tests/checkin-printer-identity.test.mjs tests/checkin-agent-cycles.test.mjs tests/checkin-host-ownership.test.mjs tests/checkin-print-host.test.mjs tests/checkin-host-worker-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/checkin-host-package.test.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm build:checkin-runtime && pnpm test:feedback-ops && vp test run --maxWorkers=4
scripts.test:feedback: pnpm test:feedback-ops && vp test run src/lib/feedback-privacy.test.ts src/lib/feedback-client.test.ts src/components/feedback/form-data.test.ts src/components/feedback/FeedbackForm.test.tsx src/lib/feedback-http.test.ts src/lib/feedback.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:gamification: vp test run --exclude '**/.hermes/**' --maxWorkers=4 src/lib/gamification.test.ts src/lib/mission-questions.test.ts src/lib/mission-questions.integration.test.ts src/lib/wts-2026-booth-achievements.integration.test.ts src/lib/mission-code-import.test.ts src/lib/persisted-json.test.ts src/lib/server-function-transport.test.ts && node --test tests/server-function-transport.browser.test.mjs
scripts.test:auth: vp test run --exclude '**/.hermes/**' --maxWorkers=1 src/lib/auth-registration.integration.test.ts src/lib/server-auth.test.ts src/lib/session-policy.test.ts src/lib/auth-request-queue.test.ts src/lib/capability-availability.test.ts src/lib/cfp-actions.test.ts src/lib/admin-actions.test.ts src/lib/cfp-admin-preparation.test.ts src/lib/cfp-config-preparation.test.ts src/lib/edition-admin.test.ts src/lib/reviewer-actions.test.ts src/lib/reviewer-pocketbase.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:checkin-browser: pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.checkin-browser.json && node scripts/run-checkin-browser.mjs
scripts.test:agenda-revision: python3 -B scripts/main-day-agenda.revise.test.py && python3 -B scripts/main-day-agenda.revise3.test.py && python3 -B scripts/main-day-agenda.revise4.test.py
scripts.test:mcs: vp test run --maxWorkers=4 src/lib/speaker-mc-migration.integration.test.ts src/lib/conference-public.test.ts src/lib/admin-actions.test.ts src/lib/public-api.test.ts src/lib/conference-guide.test.ts src/lib/mcp-public-contract.test.ts src/lib/mcp-program-data.test.ts && python3 -B scripts/mc-2026.test.py
scripts.generate:pb-types: echo 'Manual type definition required. Update src/lib/pocketbase-types.ts based on your PocketBase collections.'
scripts.test:checkin-components: pnpm test:checkin-polling && pnpm test:checkin-pairing && node --test tests/checkin-lifecycle-component.test.mjs && node scripts/run-checkin-lookup-ui.mjs && node scripts/run-checkin-recovery-history-ui.mjs && node tests/checkin-recovery-compact.test.mjs && node scripts/run-checkin-admission-retry-ui.mjs
scripts.test:checkin-lifecycle-browser: pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.checkin-browser.json && node scripts/run-checkin-browser.mjs --config=playwright.lifecycle.config.ts
